column2: WARNING Tap Changer Motor Drive Sign – Remote Command Can Move Tap Changer Gears – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:

Why this sign matters

A tap changer motor drive can run on a remote or automatic command. Hands near the gears and switches are caught when it moves.

Where to post it

On the tap changer drive cabinet door, facing the technician.

Who orders it

Substation technicians, relay and protection staff.
